figures.name: Canada Pension Plan Year's Maximum Pensionable Earnings
figures.notes: Updated annually by CRA, typically announced each November for the following calendar year. The YMPE appears in a year-indexed table on the source page. A 'presence' check for '74,600' is reliable because this number is unique on the page.

figures.name: Employment Insurance Maximum Insurable Earnings
figures.notes: Updated annually. The MIE appears in a year-indexed table on the source page alongside the premium rate. Presence check for '68,900' is sufficiently unique.

figures.name: Federal Basic Personal Amount
figures.notes: Indexed to inflation annually. The dollar amount appears explicitly on the CRA line-30000 page. '16,452' is specific enough to be a reliable presence check.

figures.name: OSFI Mortgage Qualifying Rate Floor (Stress Test)
figures.source_authority: Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions (OSFI)
figures.notes: Last changed June 2021. OSFI announces changes via press release; this page may have complex structure. The script uses label_context strategy: finds 'qualifying rate' in page text and searches nearby for '5.25'. If page structure has changed and extraction fails, result is COULD_NOT_VERIFY — never assume unchanged.

figures.name: Standard Maximum Amortization Period for Insured Mortgages
figures.notes: Policy-driven rule, not updated on a fixed schedule. The number '25' is common on web pages, so label_context strategy searches for '25' only within 300 chars of 'maximum amortization'. High likelihood of COULD_NOT_VERIFY if CMHC restructures the page — that is the intended safe outcome.

figures.name: Extended Maximum Amortization for First-Time Buyers or New Builds (Insured)
figures.notes: Introduced August 2024 for first-time buyers and new builds. As with the 25-year rule, '30' is too common for a raw presence check. Script searches for '30' within 300 chars of 'first-time' as a heuristic. Expect COULD_NOT_VERIFY if CMHC page restructures — flag for manual review.
